plugin_desc: Used to collect and monitor key metrics for MySQL database health and performance.
name: Mysql

metrics.name: mysql_uptime
metrics.description: Duration since the MySQL instance was last started, used to observe restart frequency and runtime stability

metrics.name: mysql_threads_connected
metrics.description: Number of currently open connections; new connections are rejected when approaching max_connections

metrics.name: mysql_threads_running
metrics.description: Number of threads currently executing queries, reflecting concurrent processing capacity

metrics.name: mysql_threads_created_rate
metrics.description: Rate of newly created connection threads. A rise usually means connections are not being reused.

metrics.name: mysql_threads_cached
metrics.description: Number of cached reusable threads, reflecting connection reuse capability

metrics.name: mysql_process_list_threads_idle
metrics.description: Number of process list threads in idle state, used to identify idle connection accumulation

metrics.name: mysql_process_list_threads_executing
metrics.description: Number of process list threads currently executing queries, used to assess active query concurrency

metrics.name: mysql_process_list_threads_sending_data
metrics.description: Number of process list threads in Sending data state, often related to large scans or slow result processing

metrics.name: mysql_process_list_threads_waiting_for_lock
metrics.description: Number of process list threads waiting for locks, used to identify blocking and lock contention

metrics.name: mysql_variables_max_connections
metrics.description: Configured max_connections limit used as the true connection capacity baseline

metrics.name: mysql_max_used_connections
metrics.description: Historical peak of used connections, used to assess connection pool headroom

metrics.name: mysql_aborted_connects
metrics.description: Number of failed connection attempts, possibly due to permissions, network, or configuration

metrics.name: mysql_aborted_connects_rate
metrics.description: Rate of failed connection attempts, useful for detecting authentication, network, or configuration issues

metrics.name: mysql_aborted_clients
metrics.description: Number of clients disconnected abnormally, often related to network jitter or timeout

metrics.name: mysql_aborted_clients_rate
metrics.description: Rate of abnormal client disconnects, useful for identifying network jitter, timeout, or connection pool issues

metrics.name: mysql_connection_errors_internal
metrics.description: Connection failures caused by internal server errors

metrics.name: mysql_connection_errors_max_connections
metrics.description: Connection failures caused by reaching max_connections

metrics.name: mysql_connection_errors_max_connections_rate
metrics.description: Rate of connection failures caused by reaching max_connections, indicating immediate connection saturation impact

metrics.name: mysql_connection_errors_peer_address
metrics.description: Connection failures caused by invalid or rejected peer addresses

metrics.name: mysql_connection_errors_select
metrics.description: Connection failures caused during socket select handling

metrics.name: mysql_connection_errors_tcpwrap
metrics.description: Connection failures caused by TCP wrapper access control

metrics.name: mysql_connection_utilization
metrics.description: Ratio of current open connections to configured max_connections, used to estimate connection pressure

metrics.name: mysql_slave_seconds_behind_master
metrics.description: Seconds the replica is behind its source, used to assess replication lag

metrics.name: mysql_slave_io_running
metrics.description: Replication IO thread status from SHOW SLAVE STATUS or SHOW REPLICA STATUS
metrics.query: max by (instance_id) (mysql_slave_slave_io_running_int{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_slave_io_running{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_replica_io_running_int{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_replica_io_running{__$labels__} or mysql_replica_io_running_int{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_io_running_int{__$labels__})

metrics.name: mysql_slave_sql_running
metrics.description: Replication SQL thread status from SHOW SLAVE STATUS or SHOW REPLICA STATUS
metrics.query: max by (instance_id) (mysql_slave_slave_sql_running_int{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_slave_sql_running{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_replica_sql_running_int{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_replica_sql_running{__$labels__} or mysql_replica_sql_running_int{__$labels__} or mysql_slave_sql_running_int{__$labels__})

metrics.name: mysql_variables_read_only
metrics.description: MySQL read_only setting, commonly used with replication signals to infer instance role

metrics.name: mysql_variables_super_read_only
metrics.description: MySQL super_read_only setting, commonly enabled on replicas to prevent accidental writes

metrics.name: mysql_variables_log_bin
metrics.description: Whether binary logging is enabled, used to identify primary or replication-capable instances

metrics.name: mysql_variables_log_slave_updates
metrics.description: Whether replayed replication changes are written to binary logs, useful for chained replication role analysis

metrics.name: mysql_slow_queries_rate
metrics.description: Number of slow query requests, reflecting the frequency of slow queries

metrics.name: mysql_queries_rate
metrics.description: Overall query throughput, reflecting total database access pressure

metrics.name: mysql_questions_rate
metrics.description: Rate of statements sent by clients, used to assess front-end request pressure

metrics.name: mysql_com_select_rate
metrics.description: SELECT queries, reflecting read load trends

metrics.name: mysql_com_insert_rate
metrics.description: INSERT queries, reflecting write load trends

metrics.name: mysql_com_update_rate
metrics.description: UPDATE operations, reflecting data update frequency

metrics.name: mysql_com_delete_rate
metrics.description: DELETE operations; a spike requires checking data cleanup rationality

metrics.name: mysql_com_commit_rate
metrics.description: Committed transactions per second

metrics.name: mysql_com_rollback_rate
metrics.description: Rolled-back transactions per second

metrics.name: mysql_tps_rate
metrics.description: Committed plus rolled-back transactions per second

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_row_lock_time_avg
metrics.description: Average row lock wait time; >50ms indicates severe lock contention

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_row_lock_waits_rate
metrics.description: Number of InnoDB row lock waits

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_rows_read_rate
metrics.description: Rows read by the InnoDB engine per second

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_rows_inserted_rate
metrics.description: Rows inserted by the InnoDB engine per second

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_rows_updated_rate
metrics.description: Rows updated by the InnoDB engine per second

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_rows_deleted_rate
metrics.description: Rows deleted by the InnoDB engine per second

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_deadlocks_rate
metrics.description: InnoDB deadlocks per second

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_log_waits_rate
metrics.description: Waits caused by insufficient InnoDB redo log buffer

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_data_reads_rate
metrics.description: Physical read operations issued by InnoDB

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_data_writes_rate
metrics.description: Physical write operations issued by InnoDB

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_data_fsyncs_rate
metrics.description: Fsync operations issued for InnoDB data files, reflecting data file flush pressure

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_os_log_fsyncs_rate
metrics.description: Redo log fsync frequency, reflecting transaction flush pressure

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests_rate
metrics.description: Buffer pool read requests, reflecting database read load

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_reads_rate
metrics.description: Buffer pool disk reads; high values indicate insufficient memory

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_pages_free
metrics.description: Number of free pages in buffer pool, used to estimate remaining cache headroom

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty
metrics.description: Number of dirty pages in buffer pool (not yet written to disk); indicates buffer pool utilization

metrics.name: mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total
metrics.description: Total pages in buffer pool; used to calculate buffer pool utilization

metrics.name: mysql_buffer_pool_hit_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of logical reads served by buffer pool instead of disk

metrics.name: mysql_buffer_pool_dirty_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of dirty pages in total buffer pool pages

metrics.name: mysql_buffer_pool_used_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of used pages in total buffer pool pages

metrics.name: mysql_bytes_received_rate
metrics.description: Data received, reflecting database input traffic

metrics.name: mysql_bytes_sent_rate
metrics.description: Data sent, reflecting database output traffic

metrics.name: mysql_variables_table_open_cache
metrics.description: Configured table_open_cache limit used to assess table handle capacity

metrics.name: mysql_variables_open_files_limit
metrics.description: Configured open_files_limit used as the file descriptor capacity baseline

metrics.name: mysql_open_tables
metrics.description: Number of currently open table handles

metrics.name: mysql_opened_tables_rate
metrics.description: Rate of table openings, high values may indicate insufficient table cache

metrics.name: mysql_open_files
metrics.description: Number of open files used by MySQL

metrics.name: mysql_open_files_utilization
metrics.description: Ratio of current open files to open_files_limit, used to assess file descriptor pressure

metrics.name: mysql_table_open_cache_utilization
metrics.description: Ratio of open tables to table_open_cache, used to assess table cache capacity pressure

metrics.name: mysql_table_open_cache_hits_rate
metrics.description: Table cache hit rate; <95% requires adjusting table_open_cache configuration

metrics.name: mysql_table_open_cache_misses_rate
metrics.description: Number of table open cache miss requests, reflecting table cache hit status

metrics.name: mysql_key_reads_rate
metrics.description: MyISAM key blocks read from disk

metrics.name: mysql_key_read_requests_rate
metrics.description: Logical MyISAM key read requests

metrics.name: mysql_key_cache_hit_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of MyISAM key reads served from cache

metrics.name: mysql_variables_tmp_table_size
metrics.description: Configured tmp_table_size threshold, useful for temporary table memory headroom analysis

metrics.name: mysql_variables_max_heap_table_size
metrics.description: Configured max_heap_table_size threshold, used with tmp_table_size to assess in-memory temp table limits

metrics.name: mysql_variables_innodb_buffer_pool_size
metrics.description: Configured innodb_buffer_pool_size, used as the cache capacity baseline

metrics.name: mysql_created_tmp_disk_tables_rate
metrics.description: Number of disk temporary tables created

metrics.name: mysql_created_tmp_memory_tables_rate
metrics.description: Estimated rate of temporary tables created in memory, derived from total temporary tables minus disk temporary tables

metrics.name: mysql_created_tmp_tables_rate
metrics.description: Total number of temporary tables (memory + disk) created

metrics.name: mysql_tmp_disk_table_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of temporary tables created on disk

metrics.name: mysql_binary_files_count
metrics.metric_zh_desc: SHOW BINARY LOGS 返回的 binlog 文件数量；需在高级采集选项中开启「Binary Log」
metrics.metric_en_desc: Number of binary log files from SHOW BINARY LOGS; enable Binary Log under advanced collection options
metrics.description: Number of binary log files reported by SHOW BINARY LOGS; requires gather_binary_logs

metrics.name: mysql_binary_size_bytes
metrics.metric_zh_desc: 全部 binlog 文件大小之和；需在高级采集选项中开启「Binary Log」
metrics.metric_en_desc: Total size of binary log files from SHOW BINARY LOGS; enable Binary Log under advanced collection options
metrics.description: Total size of binary log files reported by SHOW BINARY LOGS; requires gather_binary_logs

metrics.name: mysql_table_io_waits_fetch_rate
metrics.metric_zh_name: 表 IO 等待·读速率

metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait fetch events; enable Table IO Waits
metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait fetch events from performance_schema; requires gather_table_io_waits

metrics.name: mysql_table_io_waits_insert_rate
metrics.metric_zh_name: 表 IO 等待·插入速率

metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait insert events; enable Table IO Waits
metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait insert events; requires gather_table_io_waits

metrics.metric_zh_name: 表 IO 等待·更新速率

metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait update events; requires gather_table_io_waits

metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait delete events; enable Table IO Waits
metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait delete events; requires gather_table_io_waits

metrics.name: mysql_table_io_waits_seconds_rate
metrics.metric_zh_name: 表 IO 等待耗时速率

metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait time across operations; enable Table IO Waits
metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of table IO wait time across fetch/insert/update/delete; requires gather_table_io_waits

metrics.name: mysql_table_lock_waits_read_rate
metrics.display_name: Table SQL Lock Wait Read Rate
metrics.metric_en_name: Table SQL Lock Wait Read Rate
metrics.metric_zh_desc: 实例汇总的 SQL 表锁读等待事件速率；需开启「表锁 Wait」
metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of SQL table lock wait read events; enable Table Lock Waits

metrics.name: mysql_table_lock_waits_write_rate

metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of SQL table lock wait write events; enable Table Lock Waits
metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of SQL table lock wait write events; requires gather_table_lock_waits

metrics.name: mysql_table_lock_waits_seconds_rate
metrics.display_name: Table SQL Lock Wait Time Rate
metrics.metric_en_name: Table SQL Lock Wait Time Rate
metrics.metric_zh_desc: 实例汇总的 SQL 表锁等待耗时增长速率；需开启「表锁 Wait」
metrics.metric_en_desc: Instance-wide rate of SQL table lock wait time; enable Table Lock Waits
metrics.description: Instance-wide rate of SQL table lock wait time for read and write classes; requires gather_table_lock_waits

metrics.name: mysql_statement_time
metrics.metric_zh_desc: 单条语句的累计耗时，单位秒。需在高级采集中开启「语句采集」
metrics.metric_en_desc: Cumulative time for one statement, in seconds. Enable Statement Collection under advanced collection
metrics.description: Cumulative time for one statement, in seconds. Enable Statement Collection under advanced collection
metrics.query: topk(20, max by (instance_id, schema, digest, digest_text) (mysql_perf_schema_events_statements_seconds_total{__$labels__}))

metrics.name: mysql_statement_calls
metrics.metric_zh_desc: 单条语句的累计执行次数。需在高级采集中开启「语句采集」
metrics.metric_en_desc: Cumulative executions for one statement. Enable Statement Collection under advanced collection
metrics.description: Cumulative executions for one statement. Enable Statement Collection under advanced collection
metrics.query: max by (instance_id, schema, digest, digest_text) (mysql_perf_schema_events_statements_total{__$labels__}) and on (instance_id, digest) topk(20, max by (instance_id, digest) (mysql_perf_schema_events_statements_seconds_total{__$labels__}))
